triggers.name: Missing EMD Deposit at Title
triggers.action: Trigger urgent SMS to TC manager; dispatch final warning notice to buyer; prepare contract cancellation notice.

triggers.name: Unresolved Title Cloud / Lien at T-10d
triggers.action: Alert legal counsel; schedule seller lien resolution call; request payoff demand statement.

triggers.name: Novation Contractor Milestone Past Due
triggers.action: Withhold next draw milestone; schedule emergency on-site inspection.

triggers.name: Buyer Funding Unverified at T-3d
triggers.action: Alert Dispositions Manager; initiate backup buyer warm-up call queue.

triggers.name: HOA Resale Certificate Not Ordered
triggers.condition: property_in_hoa == true AND hoa_ordered_at == null AND days_since_contract >= 7
triggers.action: Create high-priority task for TC admin; submit rush fee HOA order.

triggers.name: Inspection Contingency Window Closing (<48h)
triggers.action: Send urgent notice to field inspector; file contingency extension addendum if needed.
